purpose: Separate fixed-budget disturbance, prefix-route scheduling, suffix motion, and prompt timing. Results and reports stay outside the repository.

execution.queue_lifecycle: On Linux/POSIX, generation children inherit the queue lock so an abruptly killed parent cannot release it while its child survives. SIGTERM/SIGHUP stop the generation process group and record failure. Windows supports ordinary cleanup, but hard parent termination does not preserve the queue lock; check for surviving Python/torchrun processes before restarting there. Source, image and prompt hashes are frozen at queue start and checked before each job; changes stop the queue.
execution.preflight: Every --execute invocation first runs check_attention_cuda.py in the selected Python runtime. CUDA or FlashAttention failures stop the queue before generation. A fresh timestamped JSON and log are saved outside the repository; the check uses no model weights. Dry-run does not run the check.
execution.primary: Run five variants for each case at the original seed. Compare legacy_switch versus legacy_open for route scheduling; legacy_open versus fixed_budget versus adaptive for budget design; adaptive versus adaptive_first for first-frame protection.
execution.diagnostic: Run only after reviewing primary results. Each variant differs from adaptive_first by one intervention, except timing_prompt which changes both branch prompts and is a deliberately separate conditioning test. Do not interpret timing_prompt as an isolated attention effect.
execution.confirmation: Select one candidate explicitly with --variant; pair it with legacy_open at two additional seeds. This runner does not automatically select a winner or prove input-order symmetry.
execution.resume: Skip only a matching configuration with a completed, fully decoded 81-frame video and matching SHA-256. Interrupted diffusion runs restart from their initial noise; no denoising checkpoint resume is claimed.

evaluation.opening: Inspect every frame in the first second. Compare first-frame fidelity, texture stability and blur. Sharpness scores alone can reward noise and are insufficient.
evaluation.warriors: Review full playback and dense frames 35-60. Require continuous camera parallax and changing occlusion around stationary identities; character swaps, cuts or appearance morphs do not count as a camera orbit.
evaluation.falling: Review full playback and dense frames 25-50. Track feather and rock height relative to a stable ground reference. Record first ground contact, reappearance in the air and abrupt upward jumps. Img2 still shows the feather airborne.
evaluation.boundary: The listed output frame blocks identify the nominal first post-anchor latent after removal. VAE temporal dependencies can spread artifacts beyond the block; association is not proof of causation.
evaluation.reporting: Keep videos, logs, measurements and reports in the external output directory. Record failures as failures; never silently lower resolution, frame count, steps or precision. Equal attention coefficients do not prove equal visual control.
